dedupe_keys.name: datass diagnosis of rural water supply and sanitation peru

description: Peru's housing and sanitation ministry produced DATASS, the national application that records and gives detailed data on sanitation services in rural populated centres, with indicators on access and on cleaning, operation, maintenance and chlorination of drinking water systems. Coverage is rural Peru by department, province, district and populated centre. The data are free and open to the public for viewing online, while regional and local officials manage the records. Caveats: the page does not state the survey years or offer a bulk download. Simulation uses: rural system inventories for service coverage and resilience planning. Related records: SUNASS utility benchmarking (data-sunass-peru-utility-benchmarking).
